key_insight: Current multimodal LLMs are not uniformly literate in scientific visualization: they excel on some SciVis tasks, but still fail on key quantitative and interpretation-heavy visual reasoning.
engineering_relevance: SciVis literacy should be added as a benchmark dimension for selecting, validating, and deploying multimodal AI systems in scientific workflows.
method: Benchmarked 6 MLLMs on a 49-item Scientific Visualization Literacy Assessment Test.
Covered 18 visualizations/illustrations, 8 techniques, and 11 task types.
Compared model performance against responses from 485 human participants under a closed-world protocol.
evidence_signal: The evaluation showed Gemini as the strongest model overall, with performance above the human mean on evaluated subsets, while open-source models stayed below the human baseline.
watch_item: Results are benchmark- and protocol-specific, so strong performance on this test does not guarantee robust real-world scientific visualization understanding.
paper_title: Benchmarking Multimodal Large Language Models for Scientific Visualization Literacy
